name: Get attribute rules
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the validation and system‑rule metadata for a specific CRM object type (e.g., deals, contacts, companies). Use the "attributes.update_rule" action instead if you need to modify these rules.
preconditions: The object type (e.g., deals, contacts, companies) must be a valid CRM entity.

objectType.description: The CRM object type for which to fetch attribute rules. Example values: "deals", "contacts", "companies".
CRM object type the rule applies to.

attributeInternalName.description: Internal name of the attribute the rule targets.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the rule.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the rule was created.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the rule.

importantAttributes.description: List of attributes that are required or have system‑level constraints for this object type.

id.description: Unique identifier of the important attribute.

attributeInternalName.description: Internal name of the important attribute.

isRequired.description: Whether this attribute must be provided.

isSystemRule.description: Whether this attribute is enforced by the system.
